title: Deliver a minimal portable agent operations v2
description: Review Metabrain rules, documentation, tools and process against shared repo baseline 78cb01c. Implement a self-contained minimal v2 for new and existing projects. Owner essentials: coherent Git commits each changing turn/task/issue/feature; Beads by default with features and use cases driving development; concise communication. Preserve useful intent, eliminate rule sprawl and conflicting process. Produce current-v1 versus implemented-v2 report.
acceptance_criteria: Complete portable protocol and setup; operational Beads with durable shared records; evidence-backed review and per-file migration rationale; relevant mechanical validation and copy smoke check; coherent commits pushed to configured upstream; no edits to unrelated Metabrain work.
notes:
Implemented v2: self-contained 787-word core; removed 27 rule files and four host-specific heuristics; feature/use-case Beads protocol and verified CLI/storage guide; README adoption route; per-file v1-v2 comparison; dependency-free validator and eight passing tests including copy-only fixture. Metabrain governance passed (236 Markdown files, zero warnings); hook reference routing differs from root policy. Beads remote push/pull and issue readback succeeded after local cache core.longpaths workaround. Remaining: review staged diff, Git push, remote CI, record delivery.
Delivered implementation e917a818ada696825e35f5402a4a5c095c78240d and CI refresh 523d06520735d373d842eccacf0330deed08a2b5 to origin/master; exact remote SHA verified. All eight tests and package validator passed on Windows and Linux in https://github.com/mikepeiman/agentic-operations-improvement/actions/runs/34792301316. Full comparison and migration report: docs/v1-v2-review.md. Metabrain was read-only. Package acceptance met; cross-project longitudinal effectiveness and owner acceptance are not claimed.
close_reason: Portable v2 implemented, comparison report delivered, package checks and Windows/Linux CI passed, implementation pushed. Tracker and report delivery finalized in the evidence commit.
